characters.name: ANTIPHOLUS OF EPHESUS
characters.evidence: Both Antipholus twins are sons of Egeon and Emilia; the sidecar records ANTIPHOLUS OF EPHESUS and ANTIPHOLUS OF SYRACUSE with gender_source=unknown, so the shared speech prefix cannot be joined, but neither brother is a woman.

characters.name: DROMIO OF EPHESUS
characters.evidence: Both Dromio twins are the bondmen attending the Antipholus twins; the sidecar records DROMIO OF EPHESUS and DROMIO OF SYRACUSE as gender='unknown', so the shared prefix abstains at the join.

characters.name: BALTHASAR
characters.description: an Ephesian merchant invited to dinner by Antipholus of Ephesus
characters.evidence: Folger dramatis personae: Balthasar, a merchant; Antipholus of Ephesus addresses him as 'good Signior Balthasar'

characters.name: DROMIO OF SYRACUSE
characters.evidence: Both Dromio twins are the bondmen attending the Antipholus twins; the sidecar records DROMIO OF EPHESUS and DROMIO OF SYRACUSE as gender='unknown', so the shared prefix abstains at the join.

characters.name: LUCE
characters.evidence: Folger dramatis personae: Luce (also called Nell), kitchen maid to Adriana; Dromio of Syracuse calls her 'the kitchen wench'

characters.name: ANGELO
characters.evidence: recall of "The Comedy of Errors" by William Shakespeare: He is one of the twin characters in the play (google/gemma-4-E4B-it, 2026-09-02)
